Commentary.Commentary: Right, then! That brings us to the end of an entertaining, yet a very one-sided contest. Hope you enjoyed our coverage. With this victory, England have won the Super Series as they have enough points and there's no way Sri Lanka can beat them in the remaining matches. The next match takes place in Bristol on Sunday. The action begins at 1500 IST. Do join us for it. Till then, goodbye and take care!

Man Of The Match, JASON ROY says it was fun to bat like that. Gives special credit to his team's bowlers for their fantastic performance. On his start, he says the Lankan bowlers did well to restrict them in the first 10 overs but after that, he and Hales just went for it. Says his teammates and coaches give him a lot of confidence and it helps him a lot. He goes on to say that he doesn't think too far ahead and takes it day by day. Applauds Alex Hales for playing the way he did and says that he enjoys playing with him. Ends saying that he has been playing a lot of domestic cricket, that he was getting a lot of starts but failed to convert them into big ones, so is happy to get one today.

England skipper, EOIN MORGAN says that this is certainly more of what they're like than at Trent Bridge. Also says that restricting Sri Lanka to 254 was great and Alex Hales and Jason Roy put on a batting display which certainly entertained the crowd. Credits his bowlers for the kind of pressure they applied and executing their plans to perfection. (On Rashid) Mentions that he is very versatile and he can adapt well, the way he takes the pace off is fantastic. Adds that he didn't say anything to his openers and they just went about their business. Further adds that there is no secret, they just go back and come back hard again for the next game. Ends saying that he hopes the weather is great for the next match and they can put on a similar display.

Sri Lanka skipper, ANGELO MATHEWS says 256 was below average on this wicket and they kept losing wickets at regular intervals. Says his bowlers didn't penetrate at the right time and credits Hales and Roy for the way they batted. Adds that Chandimal and Tharanga batted well but this a day they would soon like to forget. Further says that they should have had at least 300 on the board on such a wicket to give their bowlers a chance. Further adds that they don't want to fiddle too much with their batting order considering that they only have a day for the next match. Ends saying his theory is that when the wicket is good you should bat first and set a big target for the opposition.

There isn't much to say about the Lankan bowlers. They were battered, bamboozled, berated and whatever else you could think of. They lacked innovation and inspiration when the going got tough. They needed somebody to plug the run flow and more importantly, needed some spark from the field to liven things up. Just like Roy did earlier in the innings. The Islanders have been beaten hands down in all departments. A day they will soon like to forget.

With 255 to chase, the English openers came out with a positive intent, and it showed in the way they played today. Went after the opposition bowlers and left them no chance. Used their feet well, danced all over the wicket, unsettled the Sri Lankans and did it so well. Both got a ton to their names and made sure they were out in the middle to see their side home. A scintillating batting display. Barring a dropped chance off Hales, which came too late in the innings anyway, the duo played flawlessly.

Alex Hales and Jason Roy, take a bow! Finished the game with almost 16 overs still left. Few performances with the bat can better that. No better feeling in the world as the pair walks off, unbeaten with a century to their names and congratulated by their mates at the pavilion entrance.

FOUR! AND THAT WILL DO IT! What better way than this. Roy uses his feet well to get to the pitch of the delivery and smashes it through extra cover to send the ball across the ropes for a boundary. And with that hit, ENGLAND WIN THIS MATCH BY 10 WICKETS!
Full around off, defended solidly off the front foot and into the ground.
Loopy and full on middle and leg, Hales works it through mid-wicket and runs hard. Is rewarded as he is able to come back for the second.
A short delivery which has been pulled away. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Half-tracker around off, Jason gets back and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
Clipped behind square on the leg side this time for a single.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman.
2nd ODI century for Jason Roy!

SIX! AND HE DOES IT WITH STYLE! What a way to reach the milestone. Tossed up on middle and off, Roy gives the charge and murders this back down the ground. Hits it flat and gets it over the fence with ease. Gets another maximum to his name.

Full on leg, the ball goes off Roy's pads as he looks to flick this away. Goes past the vacant slip cordon as the batsmen take two leg byes. The Lankans appeal for an LBW but the umpire is unmoved. They decide to take a review and replays show that the ball would have gone on to miss the leg stump. Roy is still on strike and just a run away from his ton.
A review against an LBW decision against Jason Roy is taken.
Wide! Going down leg, wide signalled.
Another quicker one on middle and off, punched back to the bowler.
Outside off, cut away through point for a single. Which brings Jason Roy to face Prasanna now.
Full and fast outside off, driven straight to the man at covers.
Quicker one fired through outside off, Roy goes back and punches it to deep cover for a run. Moves on to 99.
PRASANNA is back into the attack.
Around off, punched away to extra cover for a single. Roy will keep strike. On 98 now.
Full toss around off, hit down to long on for a single.

JUST CLEARS THE INFIELD! Pretty sure he had his heart in his mouth as he hit that. Flighted around off, Roy steps out to that one and looks to go big over the leg side. Gets a leading edge which just goes over the cover fielder. Takes three runs for it.
Tossed up on off, Hales drives it down to long on for a run. Giving his partner every chance to get to his century as well.
Floated on off, hit straight back to the bowler.
Full around off, driven to wide long off for one.
Length ball on middle and leg, punched down to long on for one run to end the over.
A short delivery which has been pulled away. The batsmen have run through for a single.

DROPPED! How can you miss a catch now? Just sums up Sri Lanka's day, doesn't it? Length ball outside off, Hales slices this hard straight to point. But would you believe it, Gunathilaka there drops a sitter.
Wide! Way outside off, Hales goes after this but misses. Wide signalled.
FOUR! Full and outside off, Hales swings his bat hard at this. gets it past the man at short third man and away to the fence.
Fuller around off, Roy flicks this through the vacant mid-wicket area and gets one run.
On a length and outside off, played to point for a run.
MAHAROOF is back on.
The batsman has taken the risk and lofted it over the covers. The batsmen have picked up a couple of runs.
Alex Hales hits this hard to deep mid-wicket and takes a single.
Hales looks to go big again but mistimes his shot to the leg side.
Around off, Alex fails to put bat on ball.
Flighted on middle and leg, Jason drives it to the man at long on and picks up a single.

SIX! IT'S RAINING SIXES HERE! Roy says I'm still here, don't forget about me! Floated around off, Roy gets to the pitch of the delivery and hammers this back down the ground for a maximum. he's joining the party here.

SIX! ALL HAIL ALEX HALES! TAKE A BOW, SON! Hit that clean as a whistle! Full on middle, Hales shuffles across a bit, gets into position and sends it sailing into the stands over mid-wicket for a maximum. 27 runs off the over. He's just dealing in boundaries here.
SIX! OH. MY WORD! WHAT IS GOING ON HERE? Tossed up around off, Hales slogs this and slogs this hard. Sends it miles into the stands for another biggie.
SIX! BOOM! He's just letting it fly out there! Shortish around off, Hales rocks back and pulls it well over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
3rd ODI hundred for Alex Hales!
FOUR! Around off, Hales just unleashes the cut shot through the covers to pick up another boundary.
FOUR! He's getting them to the fence away! Just his day it seems. Full on middle, Hales gets this off the inside half of the bat. Still had enough power in it to send it past the mid-wicket fence.
Floated around off, Jason drives it towards long off for a run.
Driven down to long off for a single.
Another sweep from Hales and gets another top edge. And this time too, it falls safely. A single taken as the ball goes towards fine leg.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman.
Roy pushes this to covers and sets off for a single. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
Around off, played to point by the batsman.
FOUR! HE'S JUST TOYING WITH THEM NOW! Fuller and quicker around off, this time it's Jason Roy who dances down the track and bludgeons it past the long off fence for a boundary.

SIX! HE MAKES IT LOOK ALL TOO EASY, DOESN'T HE? Tossed up delivery on middle, Hales steps out of his crease and slogs it it high and mighty over mid-wicket for half a dozen. This is now officially the highest partnership for England against Sri Lanka in ODIs.
Turning in to the batsman this one, Roy turns it to square leg and runs for a single.
Quicker one just outside off, Roy goes back and punches it to the covers.
The batsman dances down the track but decides to defend it.
Jason gets to the pitch of the delivery and pushes it to mid on.
Full on off, Alex drives it down to long off. A single is taken.
The batsman plays a sweep shot. One run added to the total.
Leg bye! From around the wicket this time, Roy is struck on the pads as he looks to sweep that. The ball goes towards square leg as a leg bye is taken.

Easy runs these. Full and loopy on middle, Hales gets a top edge on the sweep shot again. It falls safely behind as it goes over the keeper's head. Fine leg is pretty square and so the batsmen can take three runs with utmost ease.
Tossed up around off, driven down to long off for one run.
Flicked this fuller delivery through mid-wicket again for a run.
Full on middle and leg, worked to mid-wicket for a single.
DANUSHKA GUNATHILAKA is brought into the attack now.
Swept away to backward square leg. End of the over.

EDGED.... AND SAFE AGAIN! Tossed up on middle, Hales gets down to sweep it away. Gets a top edge which flies over the keeper's head. The batsmen take two runs for it. And with that, we have a record made here. This is the highest opening stand for England at Edgbaston.
Quicker and straighter on the pads, Roy flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up outside off, Hales smacks it straight to long off for another run.
Full on middle and leg, hit down to long on for one run.
Straighter one darted on the pads, clipped to short fine leg.
PRASANNA comes back on to roll his arms.
On the pads, clipped to fine leg for a single to end the over.
Loopy and full on middle and off, Hales comes forward and drives it down to long on for a run.
Some nice flight on that as it's pitched outside off, Roy opens the face and helps it towards third man for a single.
SIX! BANGED! Tossed up delivery on middle and leg, Roy dances down the track and hammers it straight back down the ground for a flat six. Shot!
FOUR! EXECUTED THAT REALLY WELL! Tossed up on middle and off, Roy already knows what he wants to do. Gets into position quickly and plays the reverse sweep through short third man for a boundary.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. One run added to the total.
RANDIV is back on.
Length ball way outside off, Roy shuffles across and paddles it to short fine leg.
On the pads, nudged fine down the leg side. A good early call and that allows the batsmen to take the run quickly and safely. Good communication between the pair.
Fuller and angling in, Alex gets behind the line and defends it well.
In the air... but safe! Length ball around off, Roy swings his bat hard at this. Gets a thick top edge and the ball balloons towards third man. Falls safely as the batsmen take a single.
Wide! It's way outside the off stump and it's been signalled as a wide by the umpire.
On a length on middle and leg, punched down to long on for a single.
FOUR! Good shot. Fuller and outside off, Hales leans into it and drives it through the covers nicely to send the ball across the ropes.
MAHAROOF is back into the attack.
Hales drives it down to long on for a single.
The short of length delivery has been cut away through square on the off side.
Smart cricket that. Just rotating the strike now. Loopy and around off, Roy softly taps this towards covers and gets a run.
It's nudged to short mid-wicket for an easy run.
Floated on the stumps, Jason comes out and drives it down to long on for a single.
FOUR! Wonderfully played! Shortish outside off, Roy rocks back and smashes it through the covers. Gets it in the gap nicely and finds the fence.
SIX! Fuller and slower on off, Hales launches this over long off. Just manages to clear the ropes and gets a biggie. 13 runs off the over, an expensive ones for the Lankans.
RIGHT ON THE MONEY! What a delivery. Yorker perfectly fired in on Hales' foot, he is struck on the toes as he tries to dig this out to the leg side. Must have stung that one. Excellent delivery!
Around off, AH gets an inside edge onto his pads as he looks to play at that.

FOUR! BANG! And he's hit that well. Touch short outside off, Hales clears his front foot, makes a little room for himself and with a flat bat, slaps it one bounce across the long off fence for a boundary.
Wide! It's banged in short but it's too short. Wide signalled by the umpire.
Straying on the pads, AH whips this towards deep backward square leg and some good running between the wickets allow the batsmen to come back for the second.
Banged in short on middle and leg, Hales ducks to let it go over him.
Tossed up around off, Hales lofts this towards wide long off for a single.
Roy uses his feet to this one and drills the fuller ball down to long off for a single.
Floated around off, Alex drives it through the covers and picks up a run.
4th ODI fifty for Jason Roy!
Driven down to long off for one run.
Sliding down the leg side, it's clipped to square leg.
Full and around off, it's defended solidly off the front foot and into the ground.
PRASANNA is back on.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Touch short around off, Roy gets an inside edge to backward square for one run.
He's looking so confident and playing an aura that just oozes confidence today. length ball around off, Hales stays back and punches this to sweeper cover. Picks up a single as he does so.
Full around off, it's been driven through the covers for a run.
FOUR! WHAT A SHOT! Sent the ball packing, there! Full and on off, Roy gets forward and with excellent balance, lofts this nicely over wide mid on for a boundary.
Length ball outside off, Roy reaches out a bit and steers it to third man. One run added to the scoreboard.
PRADEEP is back into the attack.
Drinks break!
Full and around off, Hales drills it to mid off. End of the over.
Length ball on the stumps, worked towards the on side.
Back of a length around off, Roy pulls it through mid-wicket for one run. Brings up the 100 for England. Terrific stuff from the duo. Their 3rd 100-run stand in 21 matches together.
Length delivery around off, Hales opens the face and runs it down to third man for an easy single.
Full on the stumps, driven to mid on.

Ooooh... that was close! Length ball angling in on middle, Roy just manages to get some bat on it. Gets an inside edge to the leg side. The batsmen scamper for a single as there is a direct hit at the bowler's end. Roy is well in though.
Quicker one outside off, Roy makes a little room and jams it to the covers for a run.
Driven down to long off for a single.
7th ODI fifty for Alex Hales!
FOUR! Nicely placed. Tossed up on middle and off, Hales gets down on one knee and slog sweeps it over mid-wicket for a one bounce boundary.
Full and loopy on middle and off, Roy uses his feet and drives it down the ground for one run.
Floated around off, pushed to the left of the bowler.
Tossed up delivery on middle and leg, Hales dances down the wicket and hits it to long on. Gets a run for it.
Length ball outside off, shaping away a bit from the batsman, Hales opens the face and steers it down towards third man. One run added to the total and that's the end of the over.
Full and around off, a hint of away swing on that occasion, Hales defends it presenting the full face of the bat.
This length ball keeps a little low as Roy plays at it. Gets it down to third man and runs to the other end to complete a run.
Fuller length delivery around off, just nipping in back to Hales, he does well to clip it through square leg. Takes a single as he does so.
On a length and outside off, JR cuts this away to deep point for an easy single.
Full delivery by Lakmal this time, pitches it on middle, Jason drives it towards wide mid on.
Floated on middle, Roy works it through mid-wicket for one run. End of the over.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket.
Loopy and fuller on the pads, it's nudged to the leg side for one.
Quicker and straighter on middle, Roy stands his ground, goes back and punches it down to long on for a run.
Tossed up delivery on middle, driven down to long on once again for a single.
Full toss on middle and off, driven down to long on for a single.
SEEKKUGE PRASANNA is brought into the bowling attack.
Full delivery on the foot, Jason works this down to long on for a run.
Lakmal bowls a length ball this time, Roy with no foot movement defends this from within the crease.
A strange shot to play that. Got into a really awkward position. Length ball around off, JR looks to, I think, whip it through the mid-wicket region. Fails to hit it as the ball goes under his bat.
Play and a miss! Length delivery outside off, Hales slashes his bat hard at this but misses.
Fuller length delivery on middle and leg, Alex clips this to deep backward square leg for a comfortable single.
Full and outside off, pushed towards point.
LAKMAL comes back on to bowl.
Length delivery outside off, AH slices this down to third man for a run.

SIX! HE'S NAILED THAT! Back of a length delivery on middle and off, Hales picks up the length early. Gets into position quickly, rocks back and pulls it away high and handsome over the mid-wicket boundary for a maximum.
On a length and around off, punched away for no run.
Run down to third man this time by Roy for a single.
1000 ODI runs for Alex Hales!
On the pads, Hales works it square leg and picks up a single.
Back of a length on off, Hales gets on top of the bounce and works it to the leg side.
Once again Jason comes down the wicket and works it to short mid-wicket. Will get no run for it this time.

SIX! SMOKED! Tossed up delivery around off, Roy makes good use of his feet, gets to the pitch of the delivery and launches it over the long off fence for a biggie. Amazing shot! Certainly must have enjoyed that, Jason Roy.
Floated around off, Hales comes down the track and mistimes his shot to mid off for a single.
The batsman has driven it through mid off. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Loopy and around off, Roy works this wide on long on and takes a run.
Full on middle and leg, it's pushed to mid on for a fast run.
Tad short outside off, punched through the covers for a run.
Around off, poked to mid off off the back foot.
Around off, the batsman opens the face and taps it towards point. A half-stop from the fielder there allows the batsmen to take a single.
On a length and outside off, Jason has attempted to put bat on ball but fails.

Some extra bounce on that occasion! Well, good stuff. Back of a length ball around off, it rises sharply off the deck and rises upon Roy quickly. He gets an outside edge which flies towards point. Falls safely, though.
Fuller ball on middle, it's flicked to mid-wicket for a single.
MAHAROOF is back on. And he has the keeper right up to the stumps.
Powerplay 2 has been signalled! 4 players are allowed outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over.
Quicker one pushed through outside off, Roy cuts this late towards backward point.
Loopy and full outside off, Alex drives it to mid on and scampers to other other end to complete the run.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Full on middle and off, hit back to the bowler.
Floated on middle and leg, worked to mid-wicket for one run.

FOUR! EDGED AND AWAY! Tossed up around off, Roy comes forward and goes for the booming drive. He gets an edge and the ball flies through the vacant slip cordon. The ball races away to the fence for a boundary.
It's tucked behind square on the leg side for a single to end the over.
Fuller length delivery on middle, angling in, Alex clips this towards backward square leg. Crosses over to the other end for a single.
Full on middle and leg, defended towards short mid-wicket.
FOUR! FINDS THE GAP AND FINDS IT NICELY! Length delivery outside off, Hales rocks back and punches it ever so well through the gap in the covers to pick up a boundary.
Length delivery way outside off, Hales reaches out to this one and looks to slash it away but misses.
Length ball around off, punched off the back foot to mid off.
Floated on middle, Roy comfortably flicks this through mid-wicket for a couple.
Full on middle and leg, Hales pushes this to mid on for a quick run.
Flighted delivery on the pads, Alex works it to the leg side.
Roy steps out to this one and clips it away to the on side for a single.
Loopy and outside off, played to short third man. No run taken.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.

JUST DIDN'T CARRY! How close was that? Definitely an underedge there. Length ball around off, touch short this time, Roy leans ahead to pull this away but gets an underedge on this one. It falls just short of a diving Perera who gets down low to this left. It goes past him and two runs are taken.
Guided to third man for another run.
Length ball outside off, played to point.
On a length and around off, Roy opens the face of the blade and guides it down towards third man for one run.
Fuller length delivery on middle and off, Jason to the left of the bowler.
Fuller delivery on middle and leg, pushed to mid on for one.
NUWAN PRADEEP is brought into the bowling attack.
Alex pushes this to mid on and takes a quick single. Good running between the wickets.

FOUR! DISPATCHED! Tossed up outside off, Hales gets down to this one and smacks this past the bowler to send it across the fence. Hit that wonderfully well. Judged the flight correctly and punished it.
Around off, it's punched away square on the off side.
Loopy and shortish outside off, Alex camps back and punches it to covers. Prasanna there makes a good leap to field that one.
Loopy and around off, turning in, Hales gets back and punches it back.
Floated on middle, worked towards mid-wicket.
SURAJ RANDIV comes into the attack.
Fuller on middle and leg, Hales uppishly plays this towards mid on for a single to end the over.
On a length and outside off, it's run down to third man for a run.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
FOUR! LOVELY STROKE! Full and outside off, Hales leans into this one and drives it beautifully through the covers for a boundary.

DROPPED! Touch chance but it can be argued that maybe Perera could have done better. Touch short outside off, Hales waits for this and slices this one a little late. Gets an edge and it goes off the keeper's gloves. Close call as Hales gets an early reprieve. Two runs taken.
Wide! Down the leg side, wide signalled.
Length ball just going down leg, it brushes off Hales' thigh pad as he looks to flick it away. Taken nicely by Chandimal behind the stumps.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Full on the pads, it's flicked nicely through mid-wicket for three runs.
A bit slower and outside off, Jason shuffles across and opens the face to tap it towards point.
BEATEN! Excellent delivery! Fuller length delivery outside off, inviting Roy into the shot, he goes for the poke but the ball just beats his outside edge.
Length ball around off, some nice bounce on this occasion, Roy opens his body a bit as he blocks this one out.
Another wide! Fuller and way outside off, Roy once again reaches out to it but fails to get any bat on ball. Umpire calls it a wide.
Fullish outside off, Roy reaches out to it and pushes it to extra cover.
Wide! Went for the straighter one but it's too straight. Strays down the leg side as the umpire calls it a wide.
Back of a length and outside off, played to point for no run.

Full on middle and leg, Hales looks to flick this away but misses and is rapped on the pads. There's an appeal for an LBW but the umpire says no as it seemed like the ball was going down the leg side.
Length ball on middle, some good bounce on this occasion, Hales goes back and punches it to mid on.
Another length delivery outside off, slower in pace, Hales looks to hit it away but is deceived by the pace of the delivery.
Slower length ball outside off, punched away to the off side for no run.
Fuller and just outside off, not much width on offer, Hales gets behind the line and blocks it out off his front foot.
Back of a length delivery, angling in this time, tucked round the corner for a couple of runs.
Length delivery outside off, Roy gets a bottom edge as he looks to play this towards point.
On a length and way outside off, it's an easy leave for the batsman.
FOUR! SHOT! Back of a length outside off, Roy rocks back and punches it through the point region to pick up a boundary.
Outside off, Jason looks to put bat on ball but fails to do so.
Shortish and outside off, Roy slashes this had towards cover-point. The fielder there makes a good diving save to stop the ball. Saves vital runs for his side.
SURANGA LAKMAL will take the second new ball.
Back of a length delivery around off, it's punched off the back towards covers. End of the over.
Wide! It's going down leg and it is signalled as a wide.
Fuller on middle, Roy clips it towards backward square leg for one run.
On the pads this time, Hales works it to the on side for a single.
FOUR! And he's away! Fuller on middle and leg, Hales picks this up nicely and flicks it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Length ball around off, touch shorter this time and coming in, Hales is rapped high on the thigh pad as he looks to play at that.

Maharoof charging in, starts off with a length ball around off, nipping back into the batsman, it goes off the inside edge of Roy's bat as the ball hits him on the pads. A single is taken and he is immediately off the mark.
Welcome back for the chase. JASON ROY and ALEX HALES will open the innings for the home side. FARVEEZ MAHAROOF will lead the Lankan bowling charge. Here we go...
